conditions.text: The bidder must hold a valid trade licence, renewed for the current financial year.
The bidder must have a valid tax identification number and VAT registration certificate.
The bidder must have at least 5 years of general experience in construction works.
The bidder must have successfully completed at least 2 works of similar nature, each valued at not less than 150 lakh, within the last 5 years.
The bidder's average annual construction turnover over the last 3 years must be at least 300 lakh.
The bidder must show liquid assets or available credit facilities of at least 75 lakh.
The tender must be accompanied by a tender security of 6 lakh in the form of a bank guarantee or pay order.
The bidder must own or have confirmed access to at least 2 excavators and 1 concrete mixer plant.
The bidder must propose a project manager who is a graduate civil engineer with at least 10 years of experience.
The bidder must submit audited financial statements for the last 3 years.
